# Extended results (generated by code/42_extended_analysis.R, do not edit by hand)

All analyses here are secondary or post hoc. They were specified in docs/plan_extended.md before they ran, are not corrected for multiple testing, and never change the locked signature.

## 0. Reproduction check

Before any extended analysis, the locked-signature scores were recomputed and compared with the saved results (results/25_fresh_scores.csv). They match.

| cohort | n | C_index_now | C_index_saved | HR_now | HR_saved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GSE62452 | 65 | 0.592 | 0.592 | 1.397 | 1.397 |
| GSE21501 | 102 | 0.565 | 0.565 | 1.217 | 1.217 |
| GSE57495 | 59 | 0.558 | 0.558 | 1.310 | 1.310 |

## 1. Pooled analysis of the three scored cohorts (post hoc)

| cohort | n | events | C_index | HR_per_SD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GSE62452 | 65 | 49 | 0.592 | 1.40 (1.07-1.82) |
| GSE21501 | 102 | 66 | 0.565 | 1.22 (0.94-1.58) |
| GSE57495 | 59 | 38 | 0.558 | 1.31 (0.90-1.90) |

- Individual-patient Cox model stratified by cohort, risk score z-scored within cohort: HR per SD 1.30 (95% CI 1.10-1.54), p = 0.0018, 226 patients, 153 deaths.
- Within-cohort median split, cohort-stratified log-rank p = 0.0104; stratified HR high vs low 1.54 (1.10-2.14). Figure: results/42_pooled_km.png.
- Restricted mean survival time up to 24 months, high minus low risk: -1.47 months (95% CI -3.44 to 0.49), pooled by inverse variance. By cohort: GSE62452 -4.24, GSE21501 -0.38, GSE57495 -0.83. Negative means high-risk patients lived fewer months.

## 2. Is it just proliferation, or one gene? (post hoc)

Each comparator is scored exactly like the signature (z-scored within cohort). Hallmark scores are the mean z-score of the set genes with the 8 signature genes removed.

| score | pooled_HR_per_SD | p | C_GSE62452 | C_GSE21501 | C_GSE57495 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Locked 8-gene signature (reference) | 1.30 (1.10-1.54) | 0.0018 | 0.592 | 0.565 | 0.558 |
| ARNTL2 alone (top weighted gene) | 1.40 (1.18-1.65) | 0.0001 | 0.598 | 0.626 | 0.548 |
| Unit-weight 8-gene score (signs only) | 1.13 (0.95-1.33) | 0.1630 | 0.592 | 0.479 | 0.582 |
| Hallmark G2M checkpoint score | 1.25 (1.07-1.46) | 0.0058 | 0.598 | 0.571 | 0.547 |
| Hallmark E2F targets score | 1.24 (1.06-1.45) | 0.0087 | 0.598 | 0.554 | 0.544 |

- Adjusted for the G2M score: signature HR per SD 1.21 (0.98-1.50), p = 0.0787; G2M score HR per SD 1.11 (0.91-1.37), p = 0.2974. Spearman correlation between signature and G2M score by cohort: GSE62452 0.62, GSE21501 0.52, GSE57495 0.73.
- Adjusted for the E2F score: signature HR per SD 1.23 (0.99-1.53), p = 0.0601; E2F score HR per SD 1.09 (0.89-1.35), p = 0.4051. Spearman correlation between signature and E2F score by cohort: GSE62452 0.63, GSE21501 0.51, GSE57495 0.71.
- Verdict (rule in docs/plan_extended.md): the signature does NOT show independent information beyond proliferation in these cohorts (its adjusted HR CI includes 1 in at least one model).

## 4. Random-signature benchmarks (post hoc)

5000 random 8-gene sets per benchmark. Statistic: pooled stratified HR per SD across the three cohorts (and the mean C-index). A: genes drawn from the 1867-gene candidate pool used for model building (signature genes excluded), with the 8 locked weights randomly permuted. B: genes drawn from the 40 genes that passed the TCGA univariate screen, unit weights with the TCGA univariate sign, compared with the unit-weight version of the signature.

| benchmark | observed_HR | random_median_HR | random_95th_percentile_HR | empirical_p_HR | observed_mean_C | random_median_mean_C | empirical_p_C |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: random sets from the candidate pool vs locked signature | 1.30 | 1.01 | 1.26 | 0.0278 | 0.572 | 0.501 | 0.0388 |
| B: random sets from screen-passing genes vs unit-weight signature | 1.13 | 1.31 | 1.45 | 0.9876 | 0.551 | 0.580 | 0.9620 |

- Benchmark A: the locked signature is distinguishable from random sets from that pool (empirical p = 0.0278).
- Benchmark B: the unit-weight signature is not distinguishable from random sets from the screen-passing genes (empirical p = 0.9876). This asks whether the LASSO choice of 8 genes adds anything over picking any 8 screen-passing genes.

## 5. Sensitivity to the all-pairs duplicate audit

5 scored patients were flagged against TCGA or an earlier scored cohort and were removed for this rescore.

| cohort | n_before | n_after | C_before | C_after | HR_before | HR_after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GSE62452 | 65 | 63 | 0.592 | 0.612 | 1.40 | 1.45 |
| GSE21501 | 102 | 99 | 0.565 | 0.569 | 1.22 | 1.22 |
| GSE57495 | 59 | 59 | 0.558 | 0.558 | 1.31 | 1.31 |

- Pooled HR per SD after removal: 1.32 (1.12-1.57) versus 1.30 (1.10-1.54) before.
